title: proportion block props
description: "1 in 10" as an icon array: of icons in a grid, part of them in the accent colour, grouped at the start (grouped icons are read better than scattered ones), with the figure beside them.
x-ai-instructions: One chart says one thing: write takeaway as the finding, set highlight to the item that proves it, keep labels short (they are translated). On a narrated screen, give items an at anchor to the word that names them (see skill elabora-charts). Keep of at 10, 20, 50 or 100; write figure in words people say ("1 in 10").

takeaway.description: The sentence the chart proves, shown as its title: "Most incidents start with an email", not "Incidents by origin".

context.description: Only what neither the title nor the chart says (the unit, the population or the period the axes do not give), in one line under the title. Most charts need none; never a rephrasing of the takeaway.

source.description: Where the data comes from, shown under the chart.

part.description: How many in the accent colour.

figure.description: The figure beside the icons ("1 in 10"). Default: the percentage.

label.description: What the figure counts, under it ("clicked the link of the test email").

columns.description: Icons per row. Default 10, or 20 from 100 icons.

at.description: Narrated screens: the moment the counted icons fill in.

spotlightEnd.description: Narrated screens: when the voice is done with the items, so they all stand again and the highlight takes the colour. Default: the end of the line where the last item came.

revealOnBeats.description: Narrated screens with item moments: each item appears at its moment (true), or every item is there from the start and the moments only move the spotlight (false).
